name: Def Leppard Hysteria
reference: Pour Some Sugar on Me / Armageddon It: Def Leppard, Hysteria (1987, prod. Mutt Lange)
rig: Guitars recorded largely direct through Tom Scholz's Rockman units instead of miked amps, layered heavily; the Rockman's own cab voicing, stereo chorus and short echo are part of the sound
notes: Amp = Slammin MXR/Rockman X100, Distortion mode at half: the Rockman's output is cab-simulated, so the cab slot is empty. The Rockman's short stereo echo is ON by default (110 ms, feedback 0.15, mix 15%): it thickens rather than repeats. Spread with wobble 0.35 stands in for the Rockman stereo chorus. SW8 LEAD here turns that short echo OFF (the boost slot is a TS9 push). Unconfirmed [verify]: which Rockman units (X100 headphone amp vs Sustainor/XPR rack) and the Rockman echo time. Levels are unmeasured. Research: 80s-tones.md shortlist (captures and model ids checked with `tone3000.py models`).

left.label: Ibanez TS9 clean push, D0 T6 L10 (lead boost, not on the record)
